title: Five Rectangles, Perimeter 66: Find the Area | AMC 8-Style Level 4
description:
Five identical rectangles, a perimeter of 66, and no side lengths given. Can you still find the area of one?
Vantee shows two kid-friendly ways: build with equal blocks, or walk the edge and count the pieces.
Then try a seven-rectangle challenge on your own!
